title: Prostitution and Related Offenses
grade_or_penalty: Engaging in prostitution: disorderly persons. Patron: disorderly persons (higher if a minor or near a school). Promoting: 2nd to 4th degree based on conduct; promoting prostitution of a minor: 1st or 2nd degree
key_points: Covers engaging in, soliciting, promoting, and owning places used for prostitution.
Enhanced penalties when the person prostituted is a minor.
